import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Aircrafts } from 'src/app/services/aircrafts.service'; import { AirlinesService } from 'src/app/services/airlines.service'; import { UserHttpService } from 'src/app/user-http.service'; import { Seats } from 'src/app/services/seats.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-airlines', templateUrl: './airlines.component.html', styleUrls: ['./airlines.component.css'] }) export class AirlinesComponent implements OnInit { setupData: any = { aircrafts: [] }; updateData: any = { aircrafts: [] }; mustChangePassword = false; showSetup = false; constructor(private airlinesService: AirlinesService, private us: UserHttpService) {} ngOnInit() { const id = this.us.get_mail(); this.airlinesService.getAirlineByMail(id).subscribe({ next: (res: any) => { this.mustChangePassword = res.mustChangePassword; this.showSetup = this.mustChangePassword; if (res.aircrafts) this.updateData.aircrafts = res.aircrafts; }, error: err => console.error(err) }); } switchToSetup() { this.showSetup = true; } switchToUpdate() { this.showSetup = false; } setupAirline() { const id = this.us.get_mail(); this.airlinesService.setupAirline(id, this.setupData).subscribe({ next: res => { console.log(res); this.mustChangePassword = false; this.showSetup = false; }, error: err => console.error(err) }); } updateInfo() { const id = this.us.get_mail(); this.airlinesService.updateAirlines(id, this.updateData).subscribe({ next: res => console.log(res), error: err => console.error(err) }); } // Aircraft & seat management addSetupAircraft() { this.setupData.aircrafts.push({ _numAircraft:'', modello:'', seats:[] }); } removeSetupAircraft(i: number) { this.setupData.aircrafts.splice(i,1); } addSetupSeat(ai:number){ this.setupData.aircrafts[ai].seats.push({ _numSeat:'', class:'', legroom:false, isFree:true }); } removeSetupSeat(ai:number, si:number){ this.setupData.aircrafts[ai].seats.splice(si,1); } addAircraft() { this.updateData.aircrafts.push({ _numAircraft:'', modello:'', seats:[] }); } removeAircraft(i:number){ this.updateData.aircrafts.splice(i,1); } addSeat(ai:number){ this.updateData.aircrafts[ai].seats.push({ _numSeat:'', class:'', legroom:false, isFree:true }); } removeSeat(ai:number, si:number){ this.updateData.aircrafts[ai].seats.splice(si,1); } }
